name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: ₹6,000 per year delivered in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts (DBT) to landholding farmer families.

exclusions: Income tax payer in last assessment year
Serving or retired government officer or employee
Constitutional post holder
Monthly pension exceeding ₹10,000
Institutional landholders
Income tax payer in last assessment year
Serving or retired government officer or employee
Constitutional post holder
Monthly pension exceeding ₹10,000
Institutional landholders

required_documents: Landholding Ownership Document / RoR / Khasra-Khatauni / 7/12 Extract
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter your Aadhaar number, state, and mobile number to authenticate via OTP.
Fill in landholding ownership details including district, sub-district, block, village, survey/khasra number, and land area.
Upload land ownership document (RoR / 7/12 Extract / Khatauni) and Aadhaar identity copy.
Complete Aadhaar-based biometric or OTP e-KYC and submit for State/District Nodal Officer verification.
processing_time: 30-45 days for state nodal verification and inclusion in the next payment cycle
notes: Revised guidelines cover all landholding farmer families across India having cultivable land in their names. No statutory land size ceiling. Excludes income taxpayers and government servants. Mandatory biometric or OTP e-KYC and Aadhaar-seeded bank account required.
edge_cases: Joint land ownership / undivided ancestral land records (Khatauni) require co-owner partition or affidavit.
Tenant farmers or sharecroppers without recorded title deed do not qualify directly without state-specific mutation.
Land acquired after cutoff date (01-02-2019) eligible only via succession/inheritance.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care cashless hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals across India.

exclusions: Income tax payer
Government employees and organized sector workers with ESI/CGHS
Owns motorized 3/4 wheeler or mechanized agricultural equipment
Pucca house with 3+ rooms
Income tax payer
Government employees and organized sector workers with ESI/CGHS
Owns motorized 3/4 wheeler or mechanized agricultural equipment
Pucca house with 3+ rooms

required_documents: Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / Priority Household) or PM-JAY Family ID
Income Certificate from Tahsildar (if requested for state NFSA top-up)
application_steps: Visit the Ayushman Beneficiary portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) or nearest CSC / Empaneled Hospital Helpdesk (Ayushman Mitra).
Login with mobile number and verify via OTP to check family inclusion using Aadhaar number or Ration Card ID.
Select the beneficiary family member and proceed to Aadhaar e-KYC.
Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP or Biometric Iris/Fingerprint scan at CSC/Hospital desk.
Download and print the official PVC Ayushman Golden Card for cashless medical treatments.
processing_time: Instant digital card generation upon Aadhaar e-KYC authentication
notes: Benefit is up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a floater basis for secondary and tertiary care. Entitlement is determined by SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or state NFSA ration card linkage. All senior citizens aged 70 and above receive a distinct ₹5,00,000 top-up under Ayushman Vay Vandana regardless of economic status.
edge_cases: Family listed in SECC 2011 or NFSA ration card database is auto-eligible even if recent income documentation is pending.
Senior citizens aged 70+ in family qualify for top-up coverage under expanded Ayushman Vay Vandana.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
benefit_description: Financial grant assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas (₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas) in 3 direct installments for pucca house construction, plus 90-95 days of unskilled MGNREGA wages.

exclusions: Family already owns a pucca brick/concrete house anywhere in India
Owns motorized two/three/four wheeler
Income tax payer or government employee in family
Family possesses Kisan Credit Card with credit limit of ₹50,000 or above
Family already owns a pucca brick/concrete house anywhere in India
Owns motorized two/three/four wheeler
Income tax payer or government employee in family
Family possesses Kisan Credit Card with credit limit of ₹50,000 or above

required_documents: Self-Declaration Affidavit of owning no pucca house anywhere
application_steps: Verify inclusion in the Gram Panchayat Awaas+ / SECC permanent priority waiting list.
Submit Aadhaar, bank passbook, and MGNREGA job card to the Gram Rozgar Sevak or Panchayat Secretary.
Gram Panchayat surveyor conducts initial geo-tagged photographic inspection of the kutcha dwelling.
Upon administrative sanction, first installment (₹25,000-₹40,000) is credited to start plinth construction.
Subsequent installments are disbursed after stage-wise geo-tagged mobile verification (plinth level, lintel level, and completion).
application_mode: Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / AwaasSoft
processing_time: 30-90 days for Gram Sabha verification, geo-tagging, and administrative sanction
notes: Headline assistance figure is ₹1,20,000 for plain areas (₹1,30,000 for hilly/difficult states) provided in 3-4 milestone-based installments. Additional ₹12,000 provided under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) for toilet construction plus 90-95 days of unskilled MGNREGA wages.
edge_cases: Kutcha house roof made of grass/thatch qualifies; partially bricked walls with unpaved tin roof require Gram Sabha verification.
Landless rural families eligible for free homestead land allocation via District Administration.

name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_description: Full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees plus annual maintenance allowance up to ₹48,000 (Group 1 to Group 4 courses) disbursed directly to students via DBT.

exclusions: Family income exceeds ₹2,50,000 per annum
Student already availing any other government scholarship
General category students (covered under separate EWS merit schemes)
Family income exceeds ₹2,50,000 per annum
Student already availing any other government scholarship
General category students (covered under separate EWS merit schemes)

required_documents: SC Caste Certificate issued by Competent Revenue Authority
Income Certificate from Tahsildar / Revenue Officer (<= ₹2,50,000)
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with Aadhaar and mobile OTP.
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students' under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Enter academic enrollment details, college AISHE/DISE code, and upload previous qualifying marksheet.
Upload verified SC Caste Certificate and Tahsildar Income Certificate (<= ₹2,50,000 per annum).
Submit application for online verification by Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and State Nodal Officer (SNO).
processing_time: 30-60 days across Institute, District, and State level digital verification cycles
notes: Representative flagship scheme under the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Annual support covers 100% compulsory non-refundable fees plus annual academic maintenance allowance. Family annual income ceiling is strictly ₹2,50,000.
edge_cases: OBC category income limit is strictly ₹2,50,000 non-creamy layer; requires Tahsildar certificate.
Dual degree or repeater courses require special institute clearance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit_description: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free first refill and hotplate stove (worth ₹1,600+), plus ₹300 per cylinder targeted subsidy for up to 12 domestic refills per year (₹3,600 annual subsidy).

exclusions: Male applicants
Existing LPG connection in same household
Male applicants
Existing LPG connection in same household

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the adult woman applicant
Aadhaar Cards of all adult family members residing together
Ration Card / 14-Point Poor Household Declaration Certificate
Proof of Address / Migrant Self-Declaration Certificate
application_steps: Visit the official PMUY portal (pmuy.gov.in) or visit your nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).
Fill out the Ujjwala 2.0 application form specifying details of all adult family members.
Submit declaration affirming no existing LPG connection in the household.
Provide Aadhaar and Aadhaar-seeded bank account details for direct transfer of the ongoing refill subsidy.
Oil Marketing Company (OMC) performs deduplication check and releases the free LPG cylinder and stove within 7-14 days.
processing_time: 7-14 days for OMC de-duplication check and cylinder connection issuance
notes: Ujjwala 2.0 provides deposit-free LPG connection including security deposit, pressure regulator, and free first refill and hotplate stove. Annual benefit is benchmarked at ₹3,600 reflecting the targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder across up to 12 refills annually. Applicant must be an adult woman from a poor household without an existing LPG connection.
edge_cases: Migrant families do not require local ration card; self-declaration of address is accepted under Ujjwala 2.0.
Name mismatch between Aadhaar and Ration Card requires Village Pradhan verification certificate.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: Concessional revolving agricultural credit up to ₹3,00,000 at a 4% effective interest rate (7% baseline with 3% prompt repayment incentive) covering crops, animal husbandry, and fisheries.

exclusions: Defaulter with existing non-performing agricultural loan from commercial/cooperative banks
Defaulter with existing non-performing agricultural loan from commercial/cooperative banks

required_documents: Land Record / 7/12 Extract / Khasra-Khatauni (or registered lease deed for tenant farmers/sharecroppers)
Crop Sowing Certificate from Village Revenue Officer (Patwari / Talathi)
application_steps: Download the simplified one-page KCC application form from agricoop.nic.in / pmkisan.gov.in or obtain it at any rural bank branch / CSC.
Fill in personal details, Aadhaar number, existing PM-KISAN bank account details, and crop cultivation area.
Attach land title extract (7/12 Extract / Khasra) or Joint Liability Group (JLG) tenancy agreement.
Submit the completed form to any Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank branch.
Bank processes the application and issues the RuPay Kisan Credit Card within a statutory 14-day timeline.
application_mode: Bank Branch / CSC / PM-KISAN Portal Linkage
processing_time: 14 days statutory turnaround time mandated by RBI and Indian Banks Association
notes: Headline benefit reflects the standard concessional credit limit of ₹3,00,000 eligible for 4% effective interest rate (7% base interest minus 3% prompt repayment incentive). Up to ₹1,60,000 credit is completely collateral-free. Open to owner-farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and animal husbandry/fishery rearers.
edge_cases: Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers qualify under Joint Liability Groups (JLG) without land title.
Animal husbandry & fisheries farmers qualify for standalone credit limit up to ₹2,00,000.
